What we offer
Four pillars.
One platform.
Access what energy startups typically spend years trying to unlock. MC² Plus puts it all in one place, backed by the full weight of India's oil and gas sector.
01
Infrastructure
Shared access to world-class R&D laboratories, testing rigs, fabrication workshops, and technical facilities across PSU sites spanning multiple cities nationwide.
  • Lab and testing facility access at PSU R&D centres
  • Shared incubation workspace across multiple cities
  • Technical equipment and safety-certified environments
  • Storage, fabrication, and prototyping infrastructure
02
Capital
Structured access to seed funding for early validation and scale-up capital for ventures demonstrating commercial traction in the energy and industrial sector.
  • Seed grants for proof-of-concept and prototype stages
  • Scale-up equity for ventures with demonstrated traction
  • Warm introductions to co-investors and strategic LPs
  • Non-dilutive grants for specific technology challenges
03
Piloting opportunities
Real-world deployment access at operating PSU sites including refineries, pipelines, and terminals to test, iterate, and validate technology at industrial scale.
  • Field pilots at refineries, terminals, and gas grids
  • Structured problem statements from PSU technology teams
  • Fast-tracked procurement pathways for successful pilots
  • Access to operating assets across multiple geographies
  • Petrochemicals
  • Gas processing
  • ⁠Biofuels
  • ⁠Chemicals
  • Waste to energy
  • Retail & NFR etc
  • Upstream
04
Expertise
Deep mentorship and research partnerships with premier Indian and global institutions, bringing domain knowledge that shortens the path from lab to commercial deployment.
  • Partnerships with IITs, IIMs, CSIR labs, and global universities
  • Mentors from senior PSU technical and commercial teams
  • Access to global energy transition research networks
  • Regulatory guidance and policy navigation support
About the initiative
Built by the
sector itself.

India's energy transition will not be built by incumbents alone. MC² Plus is MoPNG's commitment to backing the founders, researchers, and builders creating the technologies that will define India's energy future.

By opening up the infrastructure, capital, piloting sites, and expertise of India's largest oil and gas PSUs, we are creating an unprecedented platform for energy entrepreneurship at a scale no single organization could offer alone.

How it works
From application
to deployment.
A structured programme designed to move fast and get ventures to proof points that matter for the energy sector.
01
Apply and get selected
Submit your venture for review. Selection is based on technology readiness, team strength, and fit with the energy sector problem areas defined by the PSU consortium.
02
Match with a PSU host
Each selected venture is matched with one or more PSU partners best suited to their domain and given access to infrastructure and a dedicated technical champion within the PSU.
03
Build, test, and iterate
Use the labs, facilities, and field sites to develop and validate your technology in real operating conditions, supported by mentors from the consortium and partner institutions.
04
Scale with capital and offtake
Ventures that demonstrate traction are supported with scale-up capital and connected to procurement pathways and commercial offtake within the PSU partner ecosystem.
Who should apply
Built for serious
energy builders.
MC² Plus is designed for ventures working on hard problems at the intersection of energy, technology, and climate.
Energy transition startups
Building technologies for decarbonisation, clean fuels, energy storage, or grid modernisation in the Indian context.
Downstream and midstream tech
Innovating across refining, processing, pipeline integrity, asset monitoring, or industrial efficiency for the hydrocarbon sector.
Sustainability and climate tech
Working on carbon capture, methane reduction, circular economy, or environmental compliance for the hydrocarbon value chain.
AI and industrial intelligence
Applying machine learning and advanced analytics to energy operations, predictive maintenance, or safety systems at industrial scale.
Deep-tech and advanced materials
Developing novel materials, catalysts, or industrial processes with direct application in the energy and petrochemical value chain.
Research-to-market spinouts
Translating research from IITs, CSIR labs, or international institutions into deployable commercial solutions for the energy sector.
